Prompt templates:




Create a plan template:
*****************************
Create "TODO_NAME_OF_PLAN" plan in docs/plans/TODO_NAME_OF_PLAN_FILE.md

Category: TODO_GIVE_CATEGORY_OR_REMOVE
Blocked by: TODO_NAME_OF_PLAN_FILE_OR_REMOVE
Blocks: TODO_NAME_OF_PLAN_FILE_OR_REMOVE
EPIC: TODO_NAME_OF_EPIC_OR_REMOVE

TODO_DESCRIPTION_OF_THE_PLAN_AND_REQUIREMENTS

If for some reason this plan can't or shouldn't be created with this specification or has some high risks of failing the implementation, notify immediately. You are allowed to change the naming of the plan or the header information if they are not well described, but please notify about this.
*****************************




Implement a plan template:
*****************************
Implement @docs/plans/TODO_NAME_OF_PLAN_FILE

Read the plan and the files it names before proposing anything. If the code has moved since the plan was written, say so rather than following it blindly.

Work through it in order. Stop after each section for my review — don't run the whole thing end to end.
*****************************




Clean up plans:
*****************************
Go through the _DONE_*/implemented plans and delete the plans that aren't needed anymore to avoid context bloat. If some plans have only small parts that are valuable to other plans (and check also upcoming plans from docs/templates/todo-plan-prompts.txt), then you can either include them in the not-implemented plan as a note or just modify the content of that implemented plan to include that small information (and say in the header that this is modified from the original plan to hold relating and vital information until a specific plan has been implemented).
*****************************
